Launchpad

Your Website, Lead Magnet and Signup Flow in One Chat

A master prompt, a starter template and two cheat sheets that let Claude build and publish your site while you stay in control.

What you get

  • The master prompt that runs the whole build in one chat
  • A starter template (the same kind of generator this site is built on)
  • A Click Guide listing the few steps only you can do
  • A Rollback Card to undo a domain switch in about two minutes

What you need

  • A Claude account. It works best with file tools and the Claude in Chrome extension. If Claude can't do a step, it walks you through it by hand.

Who it's not for

  • Anyone who wants a promise of sales or income. Nobody honest can give you one.
  • Anyone who wants someone else to build and run it for them.
  • Email setup is not included. It's a separate add-on.
